See the [instrumentation operation-scope rule](https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-python-genai/blob/main/instrumentation/AGENTS.md#model-call-inference--embeddings).

threads.body: Only the first choice is inspected, but DSPy supports multiple generations (`n`/`num_generations`). If choices finish differently (for example `stop` and `length`), `finish_reasons` is reduced to the first value and that value is passed as the fallback for every output message, so the span reports inaccurate per-choice results. Iterate over all choices and preserve their finish reasons in output order.

threads.body: DSPy's `LMToolResultPart` stores the call identifier in `id` and the result in `result`; it does not expose `call_id`/`content`. Consequently, this branch falls through to the `GenericPart` fallback and loses typed tool results from captured messages. Handle `tool_result` using its DSPy fields while retaining the existing fallback for other objects.
